put_rating.title: Rate an item
put_rating.description: Record the caller's value for one item on the module's 0 to 1 scale. A repeat on the same item replaces the earlier value. The caller is the rater and is never read from the request.

args.description: The key of the item being rated.
Whose rating this is, supplied by the mount from its caller. Never read from the request.

list_ratings.title: List ratings
list_ratings.description: List ratings by rater, by item, or by both, newest first. A listing names at least one of the two; an unscoped listing is refused.

delete_rating.title: Withdraw a rating
delete_rating.description: Remove the caller's own rating of one item. Similarities that rested on it are re-scored.

args.description: Whose rating to remove, supplied by the mount from its caller.
The key of the item whose rating is withdrawn.

list_similarities.title: List similar keys
list_similarities.description: The stored neighbours of one key, closest first: raters alike in taste by default, or items alike in who rated them when kind is item.

args.description: The rater or item whose neighbours to list.

recommend.title: Recommend items
recommend.description: Items the caller has not rated, ranked by what the caller's most similar raters gave them. Empty for a caller with no neighbours yet.

args.description: Who to recommend for, supplied by the mount from its caller.
How many items to return. Defaults to 10, at most 100.
